title: Claude Code bootstrap friction fixes (EIE C1 governance handoff)
objective: Remove the five Claude Code bootstrap frictions recorded in the EIE PR #259 governance handoff: worktree setup writing into consumer AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, the L4 gate refusing WS="$PWD" and make -n pr, session-deps overlaying requirements files onto venvs it does not own, the PR composer leaving human sections unfilled with no input for them, and conformance receipts pinned to an old .github revision.
success_criteria: worktree_add_wired.sh on a consumer repo with tracked AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md leaves git status --porcelain empty in the new worktree (new test red on 774acf2, green after)
local_execution_gate does not classify make -n/--dry-run/--just-print/--recon/-q/--question pr as publication; MAKEFLAGS=n stays classified (tests red then green)

make -C <dir> pr WS="$PWD" resolves the receipt workspace to the hook cwd (or a preceding literal cd); any other unresolvable WS= on make pr is denied with a message naming the fix (tests red then green); test_make_ws_does_not_expand_env stays green
session_deps_cloud.sh never installs into an existing .venv it did not create (no owner marker and no prior .l9-pip-applied); it reports that repo owner-managed without a stamp (test red then green)

compose_pr_body.py accepts an agent-authored .l9/pr/pr-intent.json bound to HEAD that supplies title, Problem and Reviewer focus; a stale head is ignored with WARN; open_pr_after_gate.sh passes it and, on an already-open PR, replaces only the composer's own unresolved markers and PATCHes the title only when intent.title is present (tests red then green)

generated/governance/coding_agent_execution is pinned to .github@3dcdeaae355b6de08562993f705084d7a3714bfd; produce_projection_bundle.py --check exits 0; coding_projection_status.py --expect-main 3dcdeaa reports CURRENT; verify_canonical_binding.py exits 0 BOUND
all touched test modules pass and make pr gate passes

in: tests for each of the above
out: agentdocs.sh behaviour on sessionStart and make ide-profile (intended consumer formatter block stays)
workspace_roots.py discovery semantics (shared with memory hydration)
removal of already-installed stale packages from existing venvs
scheduled regeneration workflow for the coding-agent bundle (needs GH_TOKEN for the private compiler)
